---
author: Test Author
format: mcanouil-typst
extensions:
  mcanouil:
    type: article
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        description: An article with no title stops the render with a message that names the title field, since a PDF/UA-1 document needs a title.
        errors: strict
    mcanouil-typst:
      shouldError: true
      printsMessage:
        level: ERROR
        regex: 'mcanouil: the document has no title, and a PDF/UA-1 document needs one; set title: in the front matter\.'
